questions.cardText:
[Zoology] Which aquatic animal is known for farming their food?
A. Damselfish
B. Pygmy seahorses
C. Swordtail squid
Answer: A. Damselfish have been observed to cultivate and protect algae gardens on rocks and coral reefs, ensuring a steady food supply by removing unwanted plants and guarding against intruders. Damselfish are also known to “domesticate” shrimps to help run their farms.
questions.de: Welcher Rifffisch ist dafür bekannt, seine Nahrung anzubauen – er pflegt und bewacht Algengärten auf Felsen und Korallen und „domestiziert“ sogar Schwebgarnelen als Helfer?
questions.en: Which reef fish is known for farming its food — tending and guarding algae gardens on rocks and coral, and even 'domesticating' mysid shrimps to help run its farms?

timeline.labelEn: A study in Nature Communications reports longfin damselfish 'domesticating' mysid shrimps in their algae farms
timeline.labelDe: Eine Studie in Nature Communications beschreibt, wie Riffbarsche Schwebgarnelen in ihren Algengärten „domestizieren“

questions.notes: The shrimp 'domestication' was shown for the longfin damselfish (Stegastes diencaeus) off Belize (Brooker et al. 2020).

questions.cardText:
[Economics] “Monetary policy” is typically implemented by which organization?
A. The department of treasury
B. The central bank
C. Commercial banks
Answer: B.
questions.de: Welche Institution setzt in der Regel die Geldpolitik eines Landes um?
questions.en: Which institution typically implements a country's monetary policy?

timeline.labelEn: Founding of Sveriges Riksbank, Sweden's central bank
timeline.labelDe: Gründung der Sveriges Riksbank, der schwedischen Zentralbank
